client_invoice_profile_company_check.name: client_invoice_profile_company_check
client_invoice_profile_company_check.value: "client_invoice_profile"."recipient_type" <> 'company' or ("client_invoice_profile"."company_name" is not null and "client_invoice_profile"."eik" is not null and "client_invoice_profile"."mol" is not null)

service_price_by_kind_check.name: service_price_by_kind_check
service_price_by_kind_check.value: ("service"."kind" = 'on_request' and "service"."price_cents" is null) or ("service"."kind" <> 'on_request' and (("service"."price_cents" is not null and "service"."price_cents" > 0) or ("service"."status" = 'draft' and "service"."price_cents" is null)))

review_ratings_check.name: review_ratings_check
review_ratings_check.value:
"review"."rating_overall" between 1 and 5 and "review"."rating_communication" between 1 and 5
    and "review"."rating_accuracy" between 1 and 5 and "review"."rating_quality" between 1 and 5 and "review"."rating_value" between 1 and 5
